comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Saw this on a sandbox customer that clicked Manage twice quickly; loop only starts when the first session is still active.

content.text: Saw this on a sandbox customer that clicked Manage twice quickly; loop only starts when the first session is still active.

From Billing settings, Manage payment methods should send the user to the hosted billing portal once. If the customer already has an open portal session created in the last ~30 minutes, our backend still requests a new session URL, then the portal responds with a redirect back to our return_url, which immediately requests another session — an infinite loop between app and portal.
Expected: reuse the active portal session or show an in-app message that a portal tab is already open. Actual: browser spins until the tab is killed; some users report 20+ hops in a few seconds.

Session create endpoint ignores billing_portal_sessions.active for the customer id and always POSTs a fresh session. Portal then rejects the duplicate with a redirect to return_url without a session token, and our page treats that as needs portal again. Short-circuit when an unexpired session row exists.
